body.name: balanced cyclic four-fold allocation
body.construction: Let \(\mathcal I_{n,r}=\{i\in\{1,\ldots,n\}:i\equiv r\pmod 4\}\), with residues relabelled as \(r\in\{1,2,3,4\}\). For rotation \(r\), folds \((\mathcal I_{n,r},\mathcal I_{n,r+1},\mathcal I_{n,r+2},\mathcal I_{n,r+3})\), with indices read modulo four, are assigned respectively to regression fitting, derivative-projection fitting, the first corrected-feature mean, and the second corrected-feature mean; the four rotation-specific statistics are averaged.
